text:
alex: Quick poll for the distracted coders among us — if your editor were a coffee order, what would it be? 
Options:
A) Vim 013 black espresso (no-nonsense)
B) VS Code 013 oat latte with syrup (friendly, lots of plugins)
C) Emacs 013 single-origin pour-over (slow ceremony, deep love)
D) Other (name-your-order)

riley: B) oat latte. feels like welcome-comfort-and-extensions :heart_eyes:

taylor: A) espresso. fast, a little intimidating, but it gets the job done :muscle:

jordan: C) pour-over. rituals, configs, and an altar of packages :book:

emma: D) nano + iced americano? low ceremony, high throughput :sunglasses:

alex: tally so far A:1 B:1 C:1 D:1 

poll-bot: Poll auto-closed after 8 minutes. Results stored to #random-archive.

riley: follow-up: which editor-coffee combo is most likely to start a heated hallway debate? :thinking_face:
taylor: espresso + arguments about keybindings, obv.

jordan: pour-over + heated paper-delve into init files.

emma: iced americano quietly judges you while you argue :coffee:
dev-bot: Reminder: free coffees in kitchen today until 3pm. Bring your own mug! :coffee:

alex: thanks for playing. should we do a pastry pairing round next? :croissant:
